items.name: Sketch
items.description: London's most Instagrammed restaurant with the famous pink Gallery room and egg-shaped toilets. Book months in advance for the ultimate viral experience.

items.name: Peggy Porschen Cakes
items.description: The most photographed cake shop in London with its iconic pink floral exterior. Stunning cakes and cookies that go viral every season.

items.name: Buns from Home
items.description: London's most talked-about cinnamon bun spot with queues round the block. Worth every minute of the wait. The brown butter bun is iconic.

items.name: The Wolseley
items.description: Grand Viennese-style café on Piccadilly that's a London institution. Celebrity spotting, incredible breakfasts and the best people-watching in the city.

items.name: Flat Iron Square
items.description: Buzzing street food and bar complex under the railway arches near London Bridge. Rotating food traders, live music and great atmosphere.

items.name: Coal Drops Yard
items.description: Stunning new shopping and dining destination in converted Victorian coal drops near Kings Cross. Independent shops, restaurants and beautiful architecture.
